faq.label: questions
faq.title: What people usually ask

items.a: Full access to every module for 14 days. No bank card needed — if it isn't for you, simply don't renew.

items.q: Will my clients see ads for other studios?
items.a: No. Clients book through the widget on your site, your Telegram, WhatsApp or Instagram — and through a client app in your colour and with your logo. There is no shared catalogue with other studios.

items.q: Who on my team sees what?
items.a: Three roles. The owner sees everything. The admin sees the schedule, clients and the dashboard. The trainer sees only their own classes and their own clients. The limit works in the interface and on the server: there is no way around it to reach someone else's data.

items.q: Can I run several studios or locations?
items.a: Yes, and it doesn't depend on the plan. One account can belong to several studios and switch between them, and inside a studio you set up locations and rooms.

items.q: Is there a dark theme and other languages?
items.a: Yes, the interface switches between light and dark and speaks English, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech and German. Time zone, currency and language are set during onboarding.

items.q: What happens to my data if I decide to leave?
items.a: The data is yours. Settings has a CSV export — clients, schedule, finances, memberships — and deletion is done at your request.

faq.notFoundLead: Write to us — we answer ourselves, no bots and no queue.

about.label: about us
about.title:
Velora is built by people
who ran studios themselves
about.lead: We are not making a “CRM for everyone”. We are making a tool for a specific job — schedule, clients, money, communication — and we answer questions ourselves instead of sending a templated reply.
about.p1: A studio's clients stay the studio's clients. Velora does not build a shared catalogue, does not show your clients someone else's ads and does not take a cut because a person came back to you.
about.p2: Right now the product is built for yoga and pilates studios — for how their schedule, memberships and trainers actually work. Other verticals will follow, and just as deliberately.

cta.lead: 14 days free. No card. No commitment. Just try it — you'll feel the difference.
